violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: OBSERVED COLESLAW IN THE WALK IN COOLER PREPARED AT 9:45A AT 44F (5HRS). PRODUCT DID NOT REACH 41F WITHIN 4 HOURS. OBSERVED TWO CONTAINERS OF CUT CABBAGE PREPARED AT 0945 (5HRS) AT 43F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna). CDI: PIC DISCARDED COLESLAW AND CUT CABBAGE IN THE WALK IN COOLER THAT WAS NOT COOLED TO 41F WITHIN 4 HOURS OF PREPARATION.
